sentences.l2: 春天来了，社区里很多人开始一起种树。
sentences.l1: Spring has come, and many people in the community have started planting trees together.

sentences.l2: 这个活动是居民自己组织的，大家自愿参加，没有人必须来。
sentences.l1: This activity was organised by the residents themselves; everyone takes part voluntarily, and no one has to come.

sentences.l2: 这种志愿服务让邻居们关系更好了。
sentences.l1: This kind of volunteer service has made the neighbours' relationships better.

sentences.l2: 每天早上，人们带着小树苗和水桶来到公园，挖坑、种树、浇水。
sentences.l1: Every morning, people bring saplings and buckets to the park, dig holes, plant trees and water them.

sentences.l2: 虽然有时候很累，但是大家都很开心。
sentences.l1: Although it is sometimes tiring, everyone is very happy.

sentences.l2: 种树不只是让城市变漂亮，它对生态保护也很重要。
sentences.l1: Planting trees is not only about making the city beautiful; it is also very important for ecological protection.

sentences.l2: 树木可以净化空气，减少噪音，还能帮助小动物和小鸟找到家。
sentences.l1: Trees can purify the air and reduce noise, and also help small animals and little birds find homes.

sentences.l2: 一位老师说：“我们种的不只是树，是在恢复生物多样性。
sentences.l1: A teacher said: "What we are planting is not just trees, but we are restoring biodiversity.

sentences.l2: ”她的意思是，不同种类的植物和动物可以一起生活，大自然才会健康。
sentences.l1: " What she meant is that different kinds of plants and animals can live together, and only then will nature be healthy.

sentences.l2: 这个项目叫“绿色家园”，是一个本地行动的好例子。
sentences.l1: This project is called "Green Home" and is a good example of local action.

sentences.l2: 它从小小的一块空地开始，现在已经扩展到五个小区。
sentences.l1: It started from a small piece of empty land and has now expanded to five residential areas.

sentences.l2: 每个参与的人都是社区建设的一部分。
sentences.l1: Every person who takes part is a part of community building.

sentences.l2: 虽然城市发展的速度很快，但我们也能做一点事来保护环境。
sentences.l1: Although the city is developing very fast, we can also do something to protect the environment.

sentences.l2: 有一位老人说：“我小时候这里有很多树，现在我们正在把绿色还给城市。
sentences.l1: An old man said: "When I was little there were many trees here, and now we are giving the green back to the city.

sentences.l2: ”年轻人和孩子也加入进来，他们学习自然知识，也学会了合作。
sentences.l1: " Young people and children have also joined in; they study knowledge about nature and have also learned to cooperate.

sentences.l2: 虽然一个人的力量很小，但是大家一起努力，就能带来大的改变。
sentences.l1: Although one person's strength is small, if everyone works hard together, we can bring about big change.

sentences.l2: 这个植树项目告诉我们，保护地球可以从身边的小事做起。
sentences.l1: This tree-planting project tells us that protecting the Earth can start from small things around us.

author_notes: Source sentence split inside a quotation, so a closing quote mark leads the next sentence; kept the split.
